"""Bad: a state-changing method toward the target (LINT-06)."""
from v3lum.core.models import Opsec


class ActiveProbe:
    name = "synthetic_active_probe"
    opsec = Opsec.ACTIVE

    def run(self, entity, ctx):
        return ctx.http.post(f"https://{entity.value}/api/graphql", json={"query": "{ __typename }"})
